notes.CnLrJin: Original Later Jin covers 1127–1234 in source. Chinese display uses Jin with source dates, not the unrelated Later Jin of 936–947. Dates and raw name remain unchanged.
notes.CnTangL: Original Later Tang Dynasty covers 763–907. Display 唐朝后期, not 后唐 (923–937).
notes.CnHChin: Retain ambiguous Early Chinese segment in English; Hmong alone translated. Source dates 1896–1941 are displayed without interpreting the period as early imperial China.
notes.JpJomo1-6: Six English stages aligned with Japanese grass-root terms in the official World Heritage pages; simplified Chinese transliteration, not updated chronology. Source dates remain untouched.
